Empress Alia I Salusa was Empress of the Known Universe (r. 803–883 AG), succeeding her father Saudir V as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. Alia was the first woman to rule the Imperium.

page.overview:
Who is Alia I Salusa?

Empress Alia I Salusa was Empress of the Known Universe (r. 803–883 AG), succeeding her father Saudir V as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. Alia was the first woman to rule the Imperium.

Alia was succeeded in 883 by her son Corrin III.
